title: Ultimate Vanilla
description: A fully configurable collection of vanilla survival tweaks
body:
**What is UV?** you may ask , it's a project that i started a long time ago for self use, and realized later how good the idea was, and how many people in the survival community need it, so after thousands of lines of code , here we are :)

`NOTE : the mod is currently in its testing phase , if you come across any bug/problem using the mod please reach our to me in discord`

# Ultimate Vanilla (Beta)

![Main screen custom Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19fa53842ef2444142fc2c0ee4e7daa7638d73ed_0.webp)

**A fully configurable collection of vanilla survival tweaks. Turn on exactly what you want, nothing you don't.**

Every feature is **disabled by default**. Browse the config screen or edit `config/ultimate_vanilla.json` to enable only what you want.

---

## Server Safety

Ultimate Vanilla is designed with server safety in mind:

- **Safe Mode** — toggle in config to instantly disable all risky features that might be flagged by anti-cheats in public servers (marked bellow)
- **Server Forced Safe Mode** — By default, the **SAFE MODE** is forced to be on, so you shouldn't worry about getting flagged by anti cheats.
- **Safe by default** — the dev is **NOT** responsible at all if someone somehow bypasses the safe mode, our mod is not and will never be a cheating panel.
- All features are disabled by default — nothing activates without explicit user choice

---

## Features

![The mod's config screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e97fac4f7bb3140e0833bd43222d4335f18212c.png)

### Harvesting
- **Tree Capitator** (risky) — Chop entire trees by breaking the bottom log.
- **Vein Miner** (risky) — Mine all connected blocks of the same type at once.
- **Right-Click Harvest** — Harvest mature crops by right-clicking.
- **Auto Replant** — Seeds are automatically replanted after harvest.
- **Silk Touch Spawners** — Mine mob spawners with Silk Touch.
- **Auto-Smelt** — Ores are automatically smelted.
- **Direct to Inventory** — Mined items go straight into your inventory.

### Mobs
- Anti Creeper / Enderman / Ghast / Wither Grief
- Silence Mobs, More Mob Heads, Confetti Creepers
- Dragon Drops Elytra, Double Shulker Shells
- Bat Membranes, Chicken Shedding, Larger Phantoms

### Trading
- Infinite Trading, Unlock All Trades
- Workstation Highlights, Villager Death Messages

### Death & Items
- Graves, Keep Inventory, Keep Experience
- XP Bottling, Armored Elytra

### Crafting
- Craftable: Blackstone, E Golden Apples, Name Tags, Horse Armor, Chainmail, Gravel, Coral
- Unpackable: Ice, Nether Wart, Wool
- Back to Blocks, Slab to Block, Dropper to Dispenser
- Rotten Flesh to Leather, Charcoal/Coal to Dye

### Block Mechanics
- Double Doors, Cauldron Concrete, Elevators (risky)
- Dispenser Planting/Placing/Harvesting
- Rotation Wrench, Kill Empty Boats, Minecart Stacking

### Combat
- **Swing Through Grass** (risky)
- **Armor Stand Swap** (risky)
- Angry Creepers, Safe Mounts, Monster Note Blocks

### Movement & QoL
- Zoom (C), **Auto Walk** (risky, Y keybind)
- **Enhanced Ladders** (risky), **Sit on Stairs/Slabs** (risky)
- **Toggle Stance** (risky, H keybind)

### Farming
- Better Bonemeal, Campfire Healing

### UI & HUD
- Coordinates HUD (J), Durability Ping, Inventory Sorting
- **Quick Armor Swap** (risky), Horse Stats

### Visuals
- Invisible Item Frames

---

## Requirements
- **Fabric Loader** >= 0.16.0
- **Fabric API** (required)
- **Mod Menu** (optional)
